summary: Iteration 4 — Pregnancies follow-up MSP pattern. Backend endpoints required by the spec (GET /api/pregnancies list, PATCH /api/pregnancies/{id}, POST /api/pregnancies/{id}/found) are NOT implemented in /app/backend/server.py — verified by both curl (405/405/404) and a new 9-test pytest module /app/backend/tests/test_iteration4_pregnancies.py which fails 7/9 with `Method Not Allowed`. The DHIS2 NEG/POS normalisation IS implemented (server.py:588-591) and the new test `test_neg_pos_counted` PASSES, confirming CPN visits with hiv_status='POS'/syphilis_status='NEG' increment DE_VIH_TESTED/DE_VIH_POS/DE_SYPH_TESTED. Frontend files (PregnanciesList.jsx, PregnancyCard.jsx, CPNForm.jsx, pregnancyCalc.js, AppLayout nav link, App.js route /app/soignant/grossesses) all exist but cannot work without the backend endpoints. Full regression suite (46 prior tests) still PASSES — no regression. Iteration 4 backend is essentially missing.

critical.issue: Endpoint not implemented. Returns 405 Method Not Allowed. The current router only declares POST /pregnancies and GET /pregnancies/{id}. The required list endpoint with nested patient + last_cpn projection is absent.
Endpoint not implemented. Returns 405. No status-update route exists; UI 'Marquer perdue de vue' and 'mark-ltfu-{id}' actions will fail.
Endpoint not implemented. Returns 404. UI 'Marquer retrouvée' (mark-found-{id}) action will fail.

Still hard-codes status='active' (server.py:273) instead of the new canonical 'en_cours'. Spec says new pregnancies should default to 'en_cours'. analytics/overview already tolerates both via $in [active, en_cours], but PregnancyCard status badge will read 'active' (no French label mapping for it) instead of 'En cours'.

No auto-creation of next appointment when client requests it. Spec requires the frontend 'cpn-auto-schedule' checkbox to result in an automatically created appointment (type='CPN', notes startswith 'Auto-planifié'). Currently this must be done client-side via a second POST /appointments call — verify CPNForm.jsx actually does this; otherwise the auto-schedule promise is broken.

integration_issues.issue: Page will crash or render empty: it calls GET /api/pregnancies which returns 405 — no list, no KPIs, no cards. Cannot be verified end-to-end until backend lands.
Both UI actions call PATCH/POST endpoints that do not exist on the backend — silent failure or toast error guaranteed.

action_items: Implement GET /api/pregnancies in /app/backend/server.py: soignant returns pregnancies whose patient.zone_id == user.zone_id; admin returns all; patient returns 403. Each row must nest `patient` (id, full_name, phone, address, zone_id) and `last_cpn` (visit_number, visit_date, hemoglobin, ...) — last_cpn = most recent cpn_visit by visit_date or visit_number.

Implement PATCH /api/pregnancies/{id} for soignant/admin accepting body {status, found_at?, ...}; allowed statuses: en_cours, perdue_vue, accouchee, fausse_couche, ivg, transferee. Return 404 if id missing.
Implement POST /api/pregnancies/{id}/found that sets status='en_cours' and found_at=now_iso(). 404 for missing.
Change POST /api/pregnancies default status from 'active' to 'en_cours' (server.py:273) so new pregnancies match the new vocabulary used by PregnancyCard.STATUS_COLORS.
Optionally: backfill existing pregnancies with status='active' → 'en_cours' (one-time migration), or ensure PregnancyCard renders the legacy 'active' value as 'En cours'.
Verify CPNForm.jsx actually posts a second /api/appointments call when 'cpn-auto-schedule' is checked, with type='CPN' and notes startswith 'Auto-planifié' — backend doesn't auto-create it.
Re-run pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iteration4_pregnancies.py after fixes — should be 9/9. Then re-run full suite for 55/55.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to ~912 lines and still mixes routers; iteration 4 will push it further. Strongly recommend splitting into backend/routers/{auth,patients,pregnancies,cpn,mpdsr,analytics,dhis2}.py before adding more endpoints.

Status vocabulary is now duplicated: server uses 'active' on POST /pregnancies, analytics tolerates both 'active' and 'en_cours', frontend STATUS_COLORS expects the new vocabulary. Centralise allowed statuses in models.py as an Enum and reference it from both POST and PATCH validators.

DHIS2 NEG/POS normalisation is implemented in server.py:588-591 by inlining literal lists. Extract to a constant like HIV_TESTED_VALUES=['negatif','positif','NEG','POS'] to avoid divergence between indicators / export / CSV paths.

POST /cpn-visits has no business rule for 'CPN1 tardive (>12 SA)' detection on the backend — currently this is only a UI hint. If the MSP report ever needs it, add a server-side `late_cpn1` boolean computed from lmp_date + visit_date.

No tests yet for /api/pregnancies, /api/pregnancies/{id}/found because those endpoints don't exist. Once added, also add a test verifying patient role gets 403 on the new list endpoint (the integration test is already in test_iteration4_pregnancies.py).
CORS still allow_origins=['*'] + allow_credentials=True (carried over). Browsers reject credentials with wildcard origins.

rca of the issue: Root cause: E1 implemented the frontend half of iteration 4 (PregnanciesList.jsx, PregnancyCard.jsx, CPNForm.jsx with WHO block, pregnancyCalc.js with Naegele/WHO_CPN_SCHEDULE, App.js route, AppLayout nav link) and the DHIS2 NEG/POS normalisation in the indicator queries, but never added the three new pregnancy endpoints to backend/server.py. Verified by `grep -n 'pregnancies' server.py` showing only POST /pregnancies + GET /pregnancies/{pregnancy_id} — no list, no PATCH, no /found. Reproduction: curl -i GET/PATCH/POST against the public URL returns 405/405/404 respectively. Mitigation: add the three endpoints + flip default status to 'en_cours' (see action_items).
